activity_summary: You sat in the cleared hall. Anne would not have another talk in a doorway. You did not spend the last of the day on the two of them. Joan went up and left the hall as she had made it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat, and did not go out again.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Would not have a second door-talk.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the hall clear, and went up.

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not having the hall become a second one.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not spending them on company.
